claim: Finds byte-for-byte duplicate media with complete SHA-256 hashes.
sandbox: fresh browser context; upload shipped duplicate JPEG fixtures; assert exact-copy group

claim: Suggests visually close photos captured within 30 seconds without calling them duplicates.
sandbox: three synthetic image records; assert only the visually close, time-adjacent pair is suggested

claim: Exports a CSV move-to-review-folder plan without changing originals.
sandbox: shipped duplicate fixtures; make decisions; inspect downloaded CSV and compare source SHA-256 before and after

claim: Saves the review workspace on this device across reloads.
sandbox: fresh browser context; make two decisions; reload and assert the saved review count

claim: The installed app reopens offline after the first visit.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; wait for service-worker control; go offline; reload and assert shell and status

claim: Free review data stays in the browser and sends no cross-origin requests.
sandbox: fresh demo context; record every request while making decisions; assert the sole origin is the local product origin

claim: Sample decisions use a separate demo workspace that can be reset or discarded.
sandbox: open ?demo=1 from a fresh context; decide, reset, leave demo, and assert the real workspace is empty

claim: The free product accepts up to 750 supported files and rejects 751 before scanning.
sandbox: 750 and 751 in-memory supported video files; assert boundary behavior without network or real media
